verdict.rationale: Entra documents Conditional Access as if-then policies, such as requiring MFA to reach an app (docs-2/19). It also documents device-based Conditional Access policies (docs-8/22) and configuring Conditional Access per application (docs-16). The pack never shows network, location or risk signals feeding policy decisions, nor group-scoped targeting. Actor tokens bypassing Conditional Access (comm-1) is a narrow token-type issue and does not contradict the core capability. Missing for 10: evidence of network/IP and named-location conditions, sign-in/user risk signals as policy inputs, group-based policy scoping, independent hands-on corroboration.
